# Tyrus Technologies

> Tyrus Technologies Pvt Ltd provides India-wide document scanning, document digitization, OCR indexing, metadata capture, and secure digital archive services for organizations with paper-heavy records.

## Primary services

- [Document digitization services](https://www.tyrustech.com/document-digitization-services): paper-to-digital conversion, OCR, indexing, quality checks, and archive handover.
- [Document scanning services](https://www.tyrustech.com/document-scanning-services-india): high-volume scanning for offices, branches, hospitals, and record rooms.
- [Bulk document scanning](https://www.tyrustech.com/bulk-document-scanning-services): planned scanning for cartons, backlogs, and multi-location archives.
- [Onsite document scanning](https://www.tyrustech.com/onsite-document-scanning-services): scanning at the client location when files are confidential or difficult to move.
- [OCR and indexing services](https://www.tyrustech.com/ocr-indexing-services): searchable PDFs, metadata capture, index sheets, and DMS-ready outputs.
- [HR document scanning](https://www.tyrustech.com/hr-document-scanning-services-india): employee files, personnel records, payroll documents, and HRMS-ready archives.

## Industries and records

- [Healthcare and medical records](https://www.tyrustech.com/medical-record-digitization-services)
